title: make repin can pin a local build of a commit that is gone
foundBy: session agent, after rewriting unpushed history left store entries for commits no branch holds
details: `scripts/repin-go.sh` takes the newest local build in the store whatever its commit. After a rebase or a squash, the store still holds builds of the commits that were replaced, and they carry the newest times. So `make repin` can pin a commit that no branch of the sibling's checkout holds any more, and its push is then held.
